sentence: This project studies how long noncoding RNA molecules control brain development and how they may cause human disease.
This project builds an automated method that uses MRI and machine learning to assess the anatomy of children with velopharyngeal anomalies before surgery.
This project tries to find chemical changes linked to bronchopulmonary dysplasia by using lipidomic, metabolomic and transcriptomic approaches.
This project studies how differences in mouse genes affect the risk of babesiosis after infection by tick transmission or needle inoculation.
This project studies how immune systems in bacteria detect foreign proteins and how phages counter that defense.
This project studies how a regulator found on the X chromosome shapes the way natural killer cells respond to viral infection in each sex.
This project uses imaging and computer methods to find out whether small molecule compounds that cause bradycardia all work in the same way.
This project tries to find out which patients with small cell lung cancer benefit most from twice-daily radiation therapy in the era of immunotherapy.
This project builds a platform that combines electrophysiology with two-photon calcium imaging in freely-moving mice to study electrical travelling waves.
This project tries to find out how cells form, stabilize and move macropinosomes.
This project studies how active genes are positioned in the genome and how chromosomal regions move inside the nucleus of human cells.
This project studies how long noncoding RNAs in tumor-associated Schwann cells help bladder cancer resist immunotherapy.
This project provides cell line engineering, gene editing and imaging tools that help researchers study how cancer cells grow and die.
This project builds a 3D model of cancer in which melanoma cells and immune cells interact, so cancer immunotherapies can be tested.
This project tests whether breast tissue features taken from mammograms and polygenic risk scores improve predictions of breast cancer risk in women.
This project helps researchers study how changing gene activity affects ocular cells and tissues by using gene editing and lentivirus.
This project studies how the genetics of multiple myeloma tumors differ between patients with African and European ancestry.
This project studies how a steroid hormone controls stem cell division in the Drosophila ovary.
This project tries to find out what causes amyloid-related imaging abnormalities after anti-amyloid immunotherapy for Alzheimer's disease.
